segments.name: Flavors & Extracts Group
segments.description: Develops and supplies flavor systems, extracts, essential oils, and dehydrated agricultural ingredients for food, beverage, and personal care customers.
segments.evidence: The Flavors & Extracts Group produces flavor, extract, and essential oil products that impart a desired taste, texture, aroma, or other characteristics to a broad range of consumer and other products.

segments.name: Color Group
segments.description: Develops and supplies natural and synthetic colors and specialty ingredients for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Color Group operates under the following trade names: ● Sensient Food Colors (food and beverage colors); ● Sensient Pharmaceutical (pharmaceutical and nutraceutical colors and coatings); ● Sensient Beauty (personal care colors, ingredients, and systems); and ● Sensient Specialty Markets (paper colors and industrial colors for plastics, leather, wood stains, antifreeze, landscaping, and other uses).

segments.name: Asia Pacific Group
segments.description: Markets the Company's flavors and colors product lines across the Pacific Rim and India, with regional products tailored to local preferences.
segments.evidence: The Asia Pacific Group focuses on marketing the Company's diverse product lines in the Pacific Rim and India under the Sensient name.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue by selling colors, flavors, extracts, and specialty ingredients to food, beverage, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial manufacturers, from small businesses to major international brands.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its natural and synthetic colors to domestic and international producers of beverages, bakery products, processed foods, confections, pet foods, personal care, pharmaceuticals, and nutraceuticals.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Biolie SAS, a natural color extraction business in France, as part of the Color segment.
changes.evidence: On February 14, 2025, the Company acquired Biolie SAS , a natural color extraction business located in France.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company renamed its Sensient Natural Ingredients product line to Sensient Agricultural Ingredients within the Flavors & Extracts Group.
changes.evidence: During 2025, the Company changed the name of its Sensient Natural Ingredients product line to Sensient Agricultural Ingredients to clearly distinguish it from the natural color activities within the Food & Pharmaceutical Colors product line within the Color Group.
